title: Antique Brass Towel Shelf, 24.7-Inch Wall Mount Brass 3-Tier Hotel Style With Drying Rack, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Antique Brass, towel shelf with drying rack, 24.7 in L x 10.4 in H x 8.9 in W, brass construction, wall mount design for space-saving bathroom towel storage and drying, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. Three-tier hotel style train rack keeps folded towels organized while the lower rack holds towels for drying. Traditional style accessory for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look; mounting hardware included. Includes towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and installation hardware. Some assembly required. Projection: 3.5 in. Product weight: 5.6 lb; shipping weight: 7 lb. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass.
